name: GlzPopover
semanticRole: Present anchored transient content such as filters, compact forms, or contextual help while preserving a clear relationship to its trigger.

material.rule: Anchored popovers use Thick Glaze with controlled widths. Reduced Transparency resolves to Solid Glaze and content-heavy interiors avoid stacked blur.

input.keyboard: Enter or Space on the trigger opens; Tab traverses interactive content; Escape closes and restores trigger focus.
input.focus: Initial focus moves only for an actionable task and closing restores the invoking trigger.
input.hover: Hover may preview only when semantics allow; no task depends on hover.
input.press: Trigger press toggles where appropriate and outside press can dismiss a modeless popover.

accessibility.role: Use dialog, group, or platform popover semantics according to actual interactivity; menus use menu semantics instead.
accessibility.name: Provide a stable accessible label or trigger relationship.
accessibility.state: Expose open, busy, invalid, and disabled states where applicable.
accessibility.value: Nested controls expose their own values and the container does not invent one.
accessibility.keyboard: Tab order is predictable and Escape dismissal with trigger restoration is supported.
accessibility.focus: Focus entry and return are deterministic and visible.
accessibility.errorAssociation: Form errors remain associated with their fields and are not hidden by dismissal.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Use direct open or close or a short crossfade.
accessibility.increasedContrast: Strengthen boundary, focus, and field state.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use system colors and remove blur and decorative shadow.
accessibility.largeText: Reflow and scroll internally at 200% text without viewport overflow.

fallbacks.reducedMotion: Use direct state changes or short crossfades.
fallbacks.forcedColors: Use system colors with no blur.
fallbacks.performance: Remove blur and saturation before altering interaction or target geometry.

content.overflow: Use controlled widths and internal scrolling; flip or shift placement before clipping against the viewport.
content.localization: Labels, forms, and help copy tolerate 30–50% expansion.
content.rtl: Start and end anchoring and directional affordances mirror semantically.

criteria: Popover remains visibly anchored to its trigger.
Compact forms avoid nested translucent layers.
Dismissal and focus are obvious without dominating the content.
